rule: The third task is short-answer multi-hop question answering over given passages, the task type of the one non-math short-answer dataset Sprague et al. ran themselves (MuSiQue; arXiv 2409.12183v3, Table 4). Among the public datasets of this type with public gold answers and an official exact-match and token-F1 scorer (HotpotQA distractor, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue-Ans), the study takes the most cited one.
correction: HotpotQA is not one of Sprague et al.'s datasets. No model output on any candidate existed when this rule was written.

sprague_free_form.MuSiQue: soft reasoning, short answer, zero-shot only, scored by a GPT-4o equivalence judge
sprague_free_form.BiGGen Bench: free response, scored 1-5 by an LLM judge
